description: Get trivia questions from the Open Trivia Database. Optionally filter by category, difficulty, and question type.

amount.description: Number of questions to return. Defaults to 10. Max 50.

category.description: Category ID to filter by. Use list_categories to get available IDs.

difficulty.description: Difficulty level. One of: easy, medium, hard.

type.description: Question type. One of: multiple (multiple choice), boolean (true/false).

name: get_questions
